propositions: Remove inline compaction from the close path to eliminate a 13m53s store lock hold, creating a need for an out-of-band compaction trigger.
Implement two-arm selection in compact-all: backfill mode (snapshot-less + ≥1 foldable event) and recurrence mode (foldable count > threshold), converging after each fold to prevent re-selection.
Schedule a 6-hourly compaction sweep via GitHub Actions, reusing the reconcile-bridge workflow pattern for store mount, bot identity, and signing key materialization on ephemeral runners.

Trigger compaction from the close path out-of-band via O(1) checks (ticket selection or stale sweep timestamp), spawning a detached worker using a stamped advisory lock to prevent concurrent folds and hold no lock across foreground writes.
Hoist git history walks outside the store write lock and batch them per sweep rather than per ticket, reducing compaction from hours to minutes on large stores.
Fix the sweep-clock stamping to occur only when a sweep actually runs, preventing false-fresh signals under sustained contention.
